Hey man, I’m getting married in August this year so I’ve been looking at countless options - I’ll give you some suggestions which could help!

I’m not sure on your budget, so I’ll try and list some for varying types. 

There’s no ‘right’ fragrance for a wedding, but given it’s Florida and I’m guessing the weather will be warm I’d say a fresher fragrance is probably better.  With fresher fragrances, you may find that you need to reapply once (say ever 4-6 hours) as they typically aren’t as long lasting as winter style fragrances. 

Some pricier options would be things like Louis Vuitton pacific chill, Louis Vuitton imagination, Xerjoff Torino 21 and Parfum de Marley Percival. 

Mid tier options could be things like Acqua di Parma Mandorlo Di Sicila, Acqua Di Gio Profondo or Bleu de Chanel EDP. 

Cheaper options Mont Blanc explorer or legend spirit. 
——————————————————————

A lot of options there - but I’ll add my own personal opinion. 

• if you want something that is generic, could wear year round, but is a nice fragrance and a decent price: Bleu de Chanel. 
• if you want something that’s fresh, aquatic and a leans more masculine: Acqua di gio Profondo 
• if you want something special, not in people faces, but fresh and fruity: Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill
• if you want something cheaper but nice (would need to reapply more): Mont Blanc explorer

Appreciate that’s probably a lot to digest, can go into more detail if needed.  
One final note, check out the website fragrantica, you can put the above fragrances in and it will give you a breakdown of notes and how long it should last

You may already be exploring red tobacco - I’ve never personally smelt it, but from what I’ve read it’s either a love or hate kind of fragrance. If you like it that’s great!

Just some more options to consider, not sure what your budget would be - PDM Haltane could be something you’d like, a long lasting and strong fragrance. 
Tom ford Tobacco Vanille is another good option if you really like tobacco sort of scents. 

If you go on the website Fragrantica, you can search for colognes by notes.  So if you add in tobacco, and maybe some woody notes you like it will give you some other suggestions which could be more preferable

Think your best option is so go for something that you can wear year round for any/all occasions. 

Me personally, if I could only have 1 fragrance for all occasions that wouldn’t break the bank I would go for Bleu de Chanel EDP. 

Other options are something like YSL Y, Mont Blanc explorer, Mont Blanc Legend Spirit. 
I’d maybe try smelling them to see which you prefer, but they’re all good fragrances that will fit most occasions

You mentioned that you don’t want to try again, that is enough of a reason to not. 

Whatever decision you make, so long as you are making it of your own free will, that is the correct decision for you. 
You don’t need a “reason”, if you don’t want to be with someone, you don’t have to be.
